predictions.drawing: designer@'s rule, Website repo board/spec-past-and-forecast.md PF1 to PF9 (7abec1756, read at source 01:52 UTC). Civic's estimate view will use PF2 (what happened solid), PF5 (gaps as gaps: a contract with no estimate is shown as 'no estimate', never filled), PF6 (record begins: the first contract date in the data), PF7 (the estimate as the green 'what was said' outline beside the contracted price, with the gap in euros and per cent, a miss as plain as a hit), PF8 (a computed track-record line per council) and PF9 (legend, source line, table view). PF3 and PF4 (forecast hatching, today column) apply only once civic shows something still in the future, such as a contract's planned end date.
